meta.name: cantera
meta.description: Runs Cantera homogeneous chemical reactors and evaluates ignition delay with mechanism provenance, conservation checks, and numerical refinement. Use for combustion kinetics, closed adiabatic ideal-gas constant-volume or constant-pressure ignition, temperature histories, or mechanism-specific ignition-delay comparisons.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 模拟燃烧反应器,算出着火延迟并核对守恒与机理来源
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在研究燃烧化学动力学、要比不同反应机理下的着火延迟
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study combustion kinetics and compare ignition delays across mechanisms

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能运行 Cantera 封闭绝热均相理想气体反应器:给定机理、初温、压力与摩尔组成,算出点火延迟,并给出温度/物种随时间的历史、守恒检查和四组数值加密对比。
howto.when: 当你有封闭绝热均相理想气体算例(已知机理、初温、压力、摩尔组成),要做定容或定压点火、温度历史,或机理间点火延迟对比时触发。

say.text: 用 h2o2.yaml 跑 1000 K、1 atm 的定容点火延迟
say.note: 会输出四组运行结果和 report.json

say.text: 把输出间距减半,看点火延迟是否仍在容差内
say.note: 触发 finer_output 加密对比

say.text: 换另一份机理 YAML,重跑同一组条件
say.note: 报告中会带上机理哈希

howto.what_en: Claude can run Cantera closed adiabatic ideal-gas reactors: given a mechanism, initial T, P and mole composition, it outputs temperature/species histories, ignition delay, conservation checks and four refinement runs.
howto.when_en: Use for closed adiabatic homogeneous ideal-gas ignition given a mechanism, initial temperature, pressure and composition: constant-volume or constant-pressure runs or temperature histories.

say_en.text: Run the constant-volume ignition delay at 1000 K and 1 atm with h2o2.yaml
Halve the output spacing and check whether the delay stays within tolerance
Swap in another mechanism YAML and rerun the same conditions
